clause_block_rule: Each clause ID must appear in exactly one visible block unless an intentional duplication is declared in clause_appears_in_blocks; duplicated clause text must be byte-identical across arms.
clause_appears_in_blocks_format: Semicolon-separated exact visible heading labels in lexical order.
clause_ids_status: TO_FREEZE: populate after FIFO/UART clause authoring; F18 requires visible regex matches to equal this array exactly.
clause_id_near_match_policy: Any near-match token not also a full match of clause_id_regex is a packet-freeze error.
ascii_identifier_policy: Python tokenize.NAME tokens are ASCII-only in author source; this is independent of design clause IDs.
